episodes.title: Day of the Dumpster
episodes.summary: Following the accidental release of long-imprisoned evil space-sorceress Rita Repulsa, a benevolent sage known as Zordon drafts a group of five teenagers to help protect the planet as Dino-powered warriors of goodness.

episodes.title: High Five
episodes.summary: Trini must overcome her fear of heights to save Billy.

episodes.title: Teamwork
episodes.summary: Kimberly and Trini gather signatures to close down a nearby dump site while convincing their teammates to work together more.

episodes.title: A Pressing Engagement
episodes.summary: Jason battles King Sphinx while trying to break a bench press record at the Angel Grove Gym and Juice Bar.

episodes.title: Different Drum
episodes.summary: Kimberly's deaf friend is the only hope to rescue a group of girls captured by the Gnarly Gnome and his hypnotic accordion.

episodes.title: Food Fight
episodes.summary: Bulk and his gang seek to ruin the food festival, while Rita sends a gluttonous pig to eat everything on Earth.

episodes.title: Big Sisters
episodes.summary: Kimberly and Trini look after a mischievous little girl named Maria.

episodes.title: I, Eye Guy
episodes.summary: Rita sends her monster Eye Guy to kidnap Billy's bright young protege.

episodes.title: For Whom the Bell Trolls
episodes.summary: Trini's favorite doll is brought to life by Rita Repulsa and commanded to capture the Rangers inside bottles.

episodes.title: Happy Birthday, Zack
episodes.summary: Zack worries that his friends have forgotten today is his birthday while Rita sends him an unwelcome present.

episodes.title: No Clowning Around
episodes.summary: The gang fights Rita's minions at a carnival in order to save Trini's cousin Sylvia who gets turned into a cardboard cutout.

episodes.title: Power Ranger Punks
episodes.summary: Baboo sneaks a magic potion into Kimberly and Billy's drinks that turns them into angry punks.

episodes.title: Peace, Love, and Woe
episodes.summary: Billy draws on the powers of his friends to rescue the girl of his dreams.

episodes.title: Foul Play in the Sky
episodes.summary: Kimberly is in trouble when her uncle Steve succumbs to a sleeping potion in the middle of flying an airplane with her on board.

episodes.title: Dark Warrior
episodes.summary: Billy is inspired by Trini's Uncle Howard - a brilliant scientist and expert in martial arts.

episodes.title: Switching Places
episodes.summary: Billy shows Kimberly a new machine he made that is supposed to transport people from one spot to another. Curious to see how well it works, they both get inside and end up switching bodies instead! Bulk and Skull show up and get inside later that day, unbeknown st to Billy or Kimberly and they switch bodies too and accidentally break the machine! Now Billy(in Kimberly's body) must fix the machine so that they can be restored.

episodes.title: Green with Evil: Part I
episodes.summary: Rita creates her own evil Green Ranger to beat the Power Rangers at their own game.

episodes.title: Green with Evil: Part II
episodes.summary: The Power Rangers work to restore Zordon and Alpha, unaware that the new kid in school is actually Rita's evil Green Ranger.

episodes.title: Green with Evil: Part III
episodes.summary: Femme fatale Scorpina joins Rita as the Green Ranger continues to battle the Power Rangers.

episodes.title: Green with Evil: Part IV
episodes.summary: An eclipse of the sun saps the Megazord's power as Rita's forces launch a full-scale assault on Angel Grove.

episodes.title: Green with Evil: Part V
episodes.summary: The mighty Dragonzord awakens after thousands of years as the Rangers try to break the spell over the Green Ranger once and for all.

episodes.title: The Trouble with Shellshock
episodes.summary: Squatt and Baboo create their own Shellshock monster to impress Rita.

episodes.title: Itsy Bitsy Spider
episodes.summary: To face Rita's newest monster, Zack must overcome his fear of spiders.

episodes.title: The Spit Flower
episodes.summary: Rita and her evil Spit Flower monster set out to ruin Kimberly's design for a float in the world peace parade.

episodes.title: Gung Ho!
episodes.summary: Jason and Tommy must learn to work together to stop Rita's Super Putties.

episodes.title: Life's a Masquerade
episodes.summary: Rita's Frankenstein monster crashes the Power Rangers' Halloween costume party.

episodes.title: Wheel of Misfortune
episodes.summary: Rita turns Kimberly's grandmother's spinning wheel into her dangerous new weapon.

episodes.title: Island of Illusion: Part I
episodes.summary: Rita traps the Power Rangers on a mysterious island where all is not as it appears.

episodes.title: Island of Illusion: Part II
episodes.summary: The Rangers must overcome their own fears to escape Rita's Island of Illusion.

episodes.title: The Rockstar
episodes.summary: Jason and his cousin Jeremy find a map that leads to a powerful ancient mirror.

episodes.title: Calamity Kimberly
episodes.summary: Kimbery's day goes from bad to worse when the Samurai Fanman captures her.

episodes.title: A Star Is Born
episodes.summary: Tommy is called to rescue his friends while given the opportunity to audition for a martial arts commercial.

episodes.title: The Yolk's on You!
episodes.summary: Rita tries to convince a monster to do her bidding after Squatt and Baboo eat the monster's eggs.

episodes.title: The Green Candle: Part I
episodes.summary: Rita is fed up with way too many battles from the Power Rangers with the aide of the Green Ranger, so she devises a plan to get revenge on the Green Ranger for turning against her.

episodes.title: The Green Candle: Part II
episodes.summary: Jason travels to Rita's Dark Dimension to try to save his weakening friend.

episodes.title: Birds of a Feather
episodes.summary: Zack teaches a young child to believe in himself, while the Rangers battle the vicious Hatchasaurus and Cardiatron.

episodes.title: Clean-Up Club
episodes.summary: Trini and her friends pitch in to clean up Angel Grove while Rita attempts to cover the world in pollution.

episodes.title: A Bad Reflection on You
episodes.summary: Rita creates a team of evil duplicates of the Power Rangers to frame them.

episodes.title: Doomsday: Part I
episodes.summary: Rita unveils her own evil Zord as she brings her entire palace from the Moon to Angel Grove.

episodes.title: Doomsday: Part II
episodes.summary: The Power Rangers fight to rescue the citizens of Angel Grove from Rita, Lokar and Cyclopsis.

episodes.title: Rita's Seed of Evil
episodes.summary: While the Rangers plant trees in the park, Squatt plants an evil seed that grows into the Octoplant.

episodes.title: A Pig Surprise
episodes.summary: Rita casts a spell on a helpless pig turning him into the Pudgy Pig monster.

episodes.title: Something Fishy
episodes.summary: Billy must overcome his fear of fish to save his friends from Rita's fishy new monster.

episodes.title: Lions & Blizzards
episodes.summary: Zack finally gets a date with the girl of his dreams at the same time as Rita turns the Noble Lion Trophy into her latest monster.

episodes.title: Crystal of Nightmares
episodes.summary: The teens go to the mountains for the weekend to study for a test while Goldar readies the Crystal of Nightmares to infiltrate the Rangers' dreams.

episodes.title: To Flea or Not to Flee
episodes.summary: Jason tries to find the owner of a stray dog while the Rangers try to save Ernie's Gym and Juice Bar from going out of business.

episodes.title: Reign of the Jellyfish
episodes.summary: Rita determined to prevent future generations from remembering the Power Rangers tries to stop them from burying a time capsule.

episodes.title: Plague of the Mantis
episodes.summary: Trini struggles to learn praying mantis style kung fu to defeat Rita's latest monster.

episodes.title: Return of an Old Friend: Part I
episodes.summary: Rita demands the Power Rangers hand over their Power Coins if they ever want to see their parents again.

episodes.title: Return of an Old Friend: Part II
episodes.summary: With their Power Coins in the hands of the enemy the Rangers have no choice but to turn to Tommy once more for help.

episodes.title: Grumble Bee
episodes.summary: Billy gets his first B on a science test, giving Rita the idea to send her Grumble Bee to Earth.

episodes.title: Two Heads Are Better Than One
episodes.summary: Jason and Tommy teach a self-defense class to women while the Rangers fight a two-headed parrot monster.

episodes.title: Fowl Play
episodes.summary: Zack juggles a day of entertaining children with orders to protest Angel Grove from the Peckster, a birdlike monster.

episodes.title: Trick or Treat
episodes.summary: Kimberly competes against Skull on a game show for a chance to win a brand-new car, while the Pumpkin Rapper seeks to ambush the Rangers.

episodes.title: Second Chance
episodes.summary: Jason and Zack coach a young boy to help him make Ernie's junior soccer team.

episodes.title: On Fins and Needles
episodes.summary: The Slippery Shark monster casts a spell over Jason and Tommy causing them to fight amongst each other and they must fight the spell by working as a team.

episodes.title: Enter... The Lizzinator
episodes.summary: Kimberly helps her younger cousin try out for the Angel Grove Junior High cheerleading team while Rita sends the mighty Lizzinator to Earth.

episodes.title: Football Season
episodes.summary: Tommy tries to learn how to play football in time to make the high school team and to stop Rita's Rhino Blaster.

episodes.title: Mighty Morphin' Mutants
episodes.summary: Tommy works on improving his memory while Rita creates a team of evil Mutant Rangers led by Commander Crayfish.

episodes.title: An Oyster Stew
episodes.summary: Zack seeks to impress Angela by giving her a pair of pearl earrings, unaware they are Rita's cursed Pearls of Stillness.

episodes.title: The Mutiny: Part I
episodes.summary: Rita Repulsa's minions abandon her when an even more evil menace arrives on the Moon.

episodes.title: The Mutiny: Part II
episodes.summary: Lord Zedd steals the power of the Zords away from the Rangers.

episodes.title: The Mutiny: Part III
episodes.summary: The Power Rangers obtain new Zords to defeat Piranhtis Head.

episodes.title: The Wanna-Be Ranger
episodes.summary: Lord Zedd attacks with a monster that can morph from one Power Ranger to another.

episodes.title: Putty on the Brain
episodes.summary: Lord Zedd casts a spell on the Power Rangers.

episodes.title: Bloom of Doom
episodes.summary: Kimberly is attacked by the Bloom of Doom, a poisonous plant.

episodes.title: The Green Dream
episodes.summary: Goldar plans to steal Tommy's Green Ranger powers.

episodes.title: The Power Stealer
episodes.summary: The Power Rangers use an unusual defense against a vain monster sent by Lord Zedd.

episodes.title: The Beetle Invasion
episodes.summary: The Stag Beetle Monster drains Tommy's powers in an attack on Angel Grove.

episodes.title: Welcome to Venus Island
episodes.summary: The Rangers face Monster Venus Fly Traps as they try to rescue Hallie from Lord Zedd's island stronghold.

episodes.title: The Song of Guitardo
episodes.summary: Kimberly is the only one who can save the Rangers from a musical spell.

episodes.title: Green No More: Part I
episodes.summary: A giant Turban Shell captures Tommy and transports him to Zedd's Otherworld.

episodes.title: Green No More: Part II
episodes.summary: Tommy attempts to retrieve the Rangers' Morphers and escape from Zedd's Otherworld.

episodes.title: Missing Green
episodes.summary: Jason's guilt about Tommy's loss of power causes even more problems for the Power Rangers.

episodes.title: Orchestral Maneuvers in the Park
episodes.summary: The Power Rangers must toot their own horns to stop Lord Zedd's Trumpet Top monster.

episodes.title: Beauty and the Beast
episodes.summary: Kimberly is captured and transformed into Lord Zedd's evil queen.

episodes.title: White Light: Part I
episodes.summary: Alpha and Zordon go on a secret mission, leaving the Power Rangers to fend for themselves.

episodes.title: White Light: Part II
episodes.summary: Zordon introduces the team to the new White Ranger and his mighty White Tiger Zord.

episodes.title: Two for One
episodes.summary: Lord Zedd makes a pair of monsters from Kimberly's stolen purse.

episodes.title: Opposites Attract
episodes.summary: Lord Zedd plans to steal Billy's magnetic polarizing gauge and wreak havoc with Earth's gravitational pull.

episodes.title: Zedd's Monster Mash
episodes.summary: Tommy faces some real Halloween monsters after he's kidnapped by Goldar.

episodes.title: The Ninja Encounter: Part I
episodes.summary: Lord Zedd tries to recruit winners of a Ninja Tournament to his cause, but the Power Rangers have other plans.

episodes.title: The Ninja Encounter: Part II
episodes.summary: The Power Rangers attempt to save their young ninja friends from the clutches of Lord Zedd.

episodes.title: The Ninja Encounter: Part III
episodes.summary: Billy must risk revealing his real identity to save his new ninja friends.

episodes.title: A Monster of Global Proportions
episodes.summary: Lord Zedd tries to sabotage the first World Teen Summit.

episodes.title: Zedd Waves
episodes.summary: Beamcaster controls the minds of Angel Grove's citizens, turning them into Zedd's Zombies.

episodes.title: The Power Transfer: Part I
episodes.summary: The Rangers must stop Zedd as he unleashes an awesome new weapon to attack the planet.

episodes.title: The Power Transfer: Part II
episodes.summary: Three departing Rangers transfer their powers to the new Rangers, who are immediately called into battle against the Silver Horns Monster.

episodes.title: Goldar's Vice-Versa
episodes.summary: Adam discovers that his attractive hiking partner is taking him on a trail to nowhere.

episodes.title: Mirror of Regret
episodes.summary: Lord Zedd tries to use the Mirror of Regret to undermine Adam's confidence.

episodes.title: When Is a Ranger Not a Ranger?
episodes.summary: Bulk and Skull save the Power Rangers from the Scatterbrain Monster.

episodes.title: Rocky Just Wants to Have Fun
episodes.summary: Lord Zedd casts a spell on Rocky, causing him to become obsessed with playing a pachinko game.

episodes.title: Lights, Camera, Action
episodes.summary: When Lord Zedd tries to break into show biz, the Power Rangers show him the true meaning of rejection.

episodes.title: Where There's Smoke, There's Fire
episodes.summary: Aisha learns the value of being part of a team when all the Rangers are needed to deal with the Flame Head Monster.

episodes.title: Scavenger Hunt
episodes.summary: Zedd turns the gang's scavenger hunt into a fight for survival.

episodes.title: The Great Bookala Escape
episodes.summary: The Rangers try to help Bookala, a friendly alien, return to his planet.

episodes.title: Forever Friends
episodes.summary: Zedd sends the huge Jaws of Destruction to destroy the Power Rangers.

episodes.title: A Reel Fish Story
episodes.summary: Zedd creates some underwater monsters to scare a young swimmer.

episodes.title: Rangers Back in Time: Part I
episodes.summary: Lord Zedd casts a spell that turns back the hands of time and turns the Power Rangers into kids. He then creates Photomare from a Polaroid camera which traps them in a photograph.

episodes.title: Rangers Back in Time: Part II
episodes.summary: Alpha attempts to save the Power Rangers and restore them to their rightful ages.

episodes.title: The Wedding: Part I
episodes.summary: Rita Repulsa drugs Lord Zedd with a love potion and launches her own attack against the Rangers.

episodes.title: The Wedding: Part II
episodes.summary: Zedd proposes to Rita and she promises to deliver the defeated Rangers as a wedding present.

episodes.title: The Wedding: Part III
episodes.summary: Rita and Zedd marry and decide to spend their honeymoon destroying the Power Rangers.

episodes.title: Return of the Green Ranger: Part I
episodes.summary: The evil Green Ranger returns and Tommy is forced to confront him alone.

episodes.title: Return of the Green Ranger: Part II
episodes.summary: The Rangers are stuck in the year 1774 and find they are unable to morph as the evil Green Ranger continues his destructive rampage.

episodes.title: Return of the Green Ranger: Part III
episodes.summary: The world hangs in the balance as the White Ranger and Green Ranger face off in a final showdown.

episodes.title: Best Man for the Job
episodes.summary: Rita and Zedd turn the class election into an ugly rivalry for Kimberly and Tommy.

episodes.title: Storybook Rangers: Part I
episodes.summary: Rita traps Kimberly, Tommy and Rocky inside a book of fairy tales.

episodes.title: Storybook Rangers: Part II
episodes.summary: Fairy tale monsters prove to be a challenge for the Rangers.

episodes.title: Wild West Rangers: Part I
episodes.summary: Kimberly is transported through a time hole to the 1800s, where she meets the Power Rangers' Wild West ancestors.

episodes.title: Wild West Rangers: Part II
episodes.summary: Kimberly helps the Rangers' ancestors morph into Wild West Rangers to fight the Needle Nose monster and save the world.

episodes.title: Blue Ranger Gone Bad
episodes.summary: Rita and Zedd create an evil Blue Ranger from a high school art project.

episodes.title: A Friend in Need: Part I
episodes.summary: The Rangers travel to Edenoi to check on Alpha's creator, when they encounter the Masked Rider, who believes they have come to harm him.

episodes.title: A Friend in Need: Part II
episodes.summary: The Rangers and the Masked Rider team up to fight Count Dregon's warriors.

episodes.title: A Friend in Need: Part III
episodes.summary: The Rangers rush back to Earth to fight off an attack by Repelletor.

episodes.title: Ninja Quest: Part I
episodes.summary: Rita's brother, Rito Revolto, promises to destroy the Power Rangers as a late wedding present for his sister.

episodes.title: Ninja Quest: Part II
episodes.summary: The Rangers search for the mythical sage Ninjor in an effort to restore their lost powers.

episodes.title: Ninja Quest: Part III
episodes.summary: The Rangers receive new Ninja Powers and new Zords to battle Rito Revolto in his attempt to destroy Angel Grove.

episodes.title: Ninja Quest: Part IV
episodes.summary: Rita and Lord Zedd unleash Vampirus against the Power Rangers' new Zords.

episodes.title: A Brush with Destiny
episodes.summary: Based on Kimberly's dream, Rita Repulsa and Lord Zedd create Artistmole, a monster who steals the color out of life.

episodes.title: Passing the Lantern
episodes.summary: Rita and Zedd attempt to steal Adam's heirloom lantern for its power.

episodes.title: Wizard for a Day
episodes.summary: Rito and Zedd turn a science teacher into "Marvo the Meanie" as Rocky attempts to teach his class.

episodes.title: Fourth Down and Long
episodes.summary: Rocky must drop-kick Rita and Zedd to save the Rangers from Centiback, a monster that changes people into footballs.

episodes.title: Stop the Hate Master: Part I
episodes.summary: The Hate Master causes the Power Rangers to fight among themselves and make plans to quit.

episodes.title: Stop the Hate Master: Part II
episodes.summary: Aisha holds the secret to stopping the Hate Master and reuniting the Rangers.

episodes.title: Final Face-Off
episodes.summary: The Face Stealer monster mugs Bulk and Skull for their mugs until it's faced with its own medicine.

episodes.title: The Potion Notion
episodes.summary: Rito's love potion creates havoc in Angel Grove.

episodes.title: A Ranger Catastrophe: Part I
episodes.summary: The Rangers must choose between saving Tommy or stopping Rito's destructive rampage.

episodes.title: A Ranger Catastrophe: Part II
episodes.summary: Tommy is forced to defend himself against Goldar and Rito.

episodes.title: Changing of the Zords: Part I
episodes.summary: Zedd and Rita capture Ninjor and his power source with plans to activate a set of dormant Zords.

episodes.title: Changing of the Zords: Part II
episodes.summary: Zedd uses the kidnapped Kimberly to blackmail the Rangers.

episodes.title: Changing of the Zords: Part III
episodes.summary: Kimberly's safety depends on the Rangers piloting Zedd's Zords.

episodes.title: Follow That Cab!
episodes.summary: Kimberly, Bulk and Skull are taken on a wild ride by the Crabbie Cabbie monster.

episodes.title: A Different Shade of Pink: Part I
episodes.summary: Rita vows to keep Kimberly out of the gymnastics competition for the Pan Global Games.

episodes.title: A Different Shade of Pink: Part II
episodes.summary: Rita and Zedd use Ninjor to bargain for the return of Katherine.

episodes.title: A Different Shade of Pink: Part III
episodes.summary: Kimberly has to make the most critical decision in her life: To stay a Power Ranger or follow her dream of becoming a world-class gymnast.

episodes.title: Rita's Pita
episodes.summary: The junk food Ravenator threatens to destroy Tommy -- from the inside out.

episodes.title: Another Brick in the Wall
episodes.summary: Katherine and Billy try to save the other Rangers from the Brick Bully.

episodes.title: A Chimp in Charge
episodes.summary: Rita and Zedd change a pet chimp used by Katherine and Aisha for a school project into a Sinister Simian.

episodes.title: Master Vile and the Metallic Armor: Part I
episodes.summary: Rita's father, Master Vile, arrives to do what she and Zedd have failed to do -- destroy the Rangers.

episodes.title: Master Vile and the Metallic Armor: Part II
episodes.summary: Master Vile and his evil crew appear to be winning the battle against the Power Rangers.

episodes.title: Master Vile and the Metallic Armor: Part III
episodes.summary: The Rangers decide the only way to win against Master Vile is to journey to a distant galaxy.

episodes.title: I'm Dreaming of a White Ranger
episodes.summary: The Power Rangers are forced to try to save Christmas -- without their powers.

episodes.title: The Sound of Dischordia
episodes.summary: Master Vile uses Dischordia to try to control the Pink and Yellow Rangers with her voice.

episodes.title: Rangers in Reverse
episodes.summary: Master Vile turns back time in an attempt to gain control of Earth and turn the Rangers into children.

episodes.title: Alien Rangers of Aquitar: Part I
episodes.summary: Zordon calls the Alien Rangers of Aquitar for help to defend the Earth after the Power Rangers are rendered helpless against the gigantic Zedd, Rita and Rito.

episodes.title: Alien Rangers of Aquitar: Part II
episodes.summary: The Alien Rangers of Aquitar appear to defend the Earth against Master Vile and his army of monsters.

episodes.title: Climb Every Fountain
episodes.summary: Billy and the young Rangers devise a scheme to outsmart the monsters.

episodes.title: The Alien Trap
episodes.summary: Billy and the young Rangers attempt to free the Alien Rangers from a toxic lake.

episodes.title: Attack of the 60' Bulk
episodes.summary: Rita and Zedd turn Bulk into the Brat Boy monster.

episodes.title: Water You Thinking?
episodes.summary: With the child Rangers journeying through a time portal, Zedd sends Witchblade to keep the Alien Rangers from hydrating.

episodes.title: Along Came a Spider
episodes.summary: In the distant past, Adam searches across Korea for his Zeo Crystal.

episodes.title: Sowing the Seas of Evil
episodes.summary: As Katherine and Tommy seek their crystals, Lord Zedd, aiming to thwart the Alien Rangers, prepares to bring the Emperor of the Dark Waters of Aquitar, Hydro Hog, to Earth.

episodes.title: Hogday Afternoon: Part I
episodes.summary: Zedd and Rita send the Hydro Hog to Earth to suck up all the water.

episodes.title: Hogday Afternoon: Part II
episodes.summary: Aisha faces a difficult decision in her Zeo Quest while the Alien Rangers battle Hydro Hog.
